settings.title: US delivery (2–3 business days)
settings.text: Most US orders arrive within 2–3 business days after dispatch. Rural areas may take one extra day—we will keep you updated by email.

settings.title: Tracked from door to door
settings.text: Every order ships with a tracking link. Use it in your shipping confirmation email or visit your account to follow your parcel.

settings.title: Processing time
settings.text: We pack orders within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday, excluding holidays). You will get a dispatch email when your order is on its way.

settings.title: Worldwide shipping
settings.text: We ship internationally with secure carriers. Duties and taxes, if applicable, are shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.title: Shipping
settings.lead: Fast, tracked delivery so your winter layers arrive when you need them.
settings.note: Questions about a shipment? Email support@girlswinter.com with your order number and we will help within one business day.
